m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Fine! You win! Take the silver sword! Take Shango's Lightning!
The other blade? I'll never tell... Okay, okay! I'll tell!
I gave it to one of the Umbra Queen's agents, a Goliath called Ranzan. It dwells in a jungle clearing nearby.
A Wizard? What a delicious morsel!
<ITALICS>You track Ranzan to this jungle clearing. The smell of rotting plants and meat is almost overpowering. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>Once you defeat the Ranzan, you find a crude but effective looking iron blade. This must be Shango's Thunder. </ITALICS>
I know a ritual to find the missing gem eyes, but you would need Shango's Blades to find them.
Shango is the spirit of war and strength, who cleaves through deception. But his tomb was robbed and his blades stolen.
The blades, Shango's Thunder and Shango's Lightning, were stolen by a Gorilla Spider Witch named Oya Bloodstorm.
Track Oya Bloodstorm to her Cliff Cave and get the blades from her. Then return to me.
Defeat the Gorilla Spider Witch, Oya Bloodstorm, and get Shango's blades. Then bring them here.
